title: HR Business Partner (HRBP) – Manufacturing Operations
description:
**About Company:**
Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B, and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operating across the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark, and North Cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages, and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners make a personalized statement through customization.

While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

For more about Group Bayport, please visit:

* **Website:**
  https://groupbayport.com/about-us/
* **LinkedIn:**
  https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/

**Designation:**
HR Business Partner (HRBP) – Manufacturing Operations

**Location:**
Gandhinagar ( Gujarat )

**About the Role**

As an HR Business Partner (HRBP) for our Manufacturing Plant, you will serve as a strategic consultant and on-ground people leader for our production, supply chain, quality, and plant operations teams. You will align human capital strategy with manufacturing output, safety, and quality goals. In this role, you will drive shop-floor workforce planning, oversee industrial and employee relations, manage statutory factory compliance, and leverage people analytics to foster a high-performing, safe, and engaged plant culture.

Key Responsibilities

**Strategic Business Partnering & Shop-Floor Workforce Planning**

* Partner closely with the Plant Head, production managers, and operational leaders to design and execute HR strategies that directly support manufacturing KPIs, productivity targets, and turnaround times.
* Lead strategic workforce planning for both on-roll and contractual/off-roll shop-floor staff, managing shift scheduling alignments, seasonal volume ramp-ups, and succession planning for critical technical roles.
* Drive change management efforts on the plant floor by effectively communicating process changes, automation upgrades, and organizational shifts to minimize resistance and maintain operational continuity.

**Talent Management, Retention & Technical Capability Development**

* Oversee the end-to-end talent lifecycle for plant personnel, from blue-collar/technical hiring and onboarding to retention and performance management.
* Partner with production and quality leads to identify skill gaps, design targeted technical/safety training interventions, implement skill-matrix programs, and build career progression frameworks for operators and supervisors.
* Facilitate performance appraisal cycles, shop-floor KPI tracking, and structured performance improvement plans (PIPs).

**Industrial Relations (IR), Employee Engagement & Plant Culture**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to plant leadership and workers on shop-floor grievances, conflict resolution, disciplinary proceedings, and domestic inquiries.
* Foster a collaborative, safe, and high-morale shop-floor environment through regular town halls, skip-level meetings, worker welfare committees, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage vendor and labor contractor relationships to ensure seamless manpower supply, fair treatment, and adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).

**Statutory Compliance, Safety & Governance**

* Ensure 100% adherence to statutory labor and factory laws (including the Factories Act, Contract Labour (R&A) Act, Industrial Disputes Act, PF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, and Payment of Bonus/Gratuity Acts) and manage external labor inspections and audits.
* Partner with the Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) team to promote a zero-incident safety culture, ensuring timely compliance with safety training and statutory welfare requirements.
* Develop, update, and audit plant HR policies, standing orders, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain operational excellence.

**Compensation, Timekeeping & HR Analytics**

* Oversee shift rosters, biometric attendance tracking, overtime (OT) governance, and accurate payroll inputs for both on-roll employees and contract workers.
* Collaborate on wage benchmarking, production-linked incentive structures, and employee welfare/benefits administration.
* Leverage HR analytics and plant metrics (absenteeism, attrition, overtime costs, productivity per headcount) to deliver data-backed insights to leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree, MBA in HR, or MSW / Post Graduate Diploma in Industrial Relations & Personnel Management (IRPM) is strongly preferred.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum of 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 4–5 years as a Plant HRBP or HR Manager in a manufacturing, printing, packaging, or industrial production environment.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience working with modern HRMS and time-office/biometric systems; direct experience with Keka HR is a distinct advantage.
* **Certifications:**
  Professional HR credentials (SHRM-SCP, SPHR) or certifications in Labor Laws & Industrial Relations are highly desirable.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

* **Industrial & Labor Law Mastery:**
  In-depth, practical knowledge of Indian factory regulations, contract labor management, statutory filings, and handling labor authorities.
* **Shop-Floor Acumen:**
  Ability to connect HR initiatives directly to manufacturing efficiency, safety, quality, and cost control.
* **Stakeholder & Conflict Management:**
  Strong mediation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels—from machine operators to senior plant leadership.
* **Agility & Resilience:**
  Proven ability to handle high-pressure situations, shift-based operations, and rapid scale-up demands in a fast-paced manufacturing setup.
* **Data Fluency:**
  Capability to track and interpret plant workforce metrics (shrinkage, attrition, OT trends) to drive proactive people decisions.

title: Manager
description:
**HRBP – International SBU**
To drive HR processes / initiatives from employee onboarding to employee exit (entire life cycle) along with partnering with International BU stakeholders, supporting, managing employee escalations / grievances, IR Issues and applying organization policies to support delivery and execute growth programs for all International employees
  
  

* To identify and implement key HR practices to drive the International SBU.
* Work closely with the Business leaders to ensure we are optimally human resourced as per the requirements
* Work closely with various functions to remain within budgets for contract labor employed on our premises
* Always work for optimal utilization of Human Resources. Excess / under to be pointed out to respective decision makers for appropriate actions
* Ensure right staffing levels by regular monitoring. Ensure to work with teams to recruit quality talents in the organization
* Ensure the recruited talents are rightly on-boarded in the organization
* Work with the team to maintain the parity in the compensation
* Employee engagement: Work with cross functional teams to build and strengthen the employee engagement initiatives currently undertaken and propose new initiatives within the budgetary limits
* Ensure that, every employee has a Job Description, KRA, KPI as per various statutory audit requirements in the required format and ensure to maintain the same in organizational format too
* Work with businesses to define where the accountability and responsibility lies in the units
* Work with the line of business to have PMS system in place with SMART goals set, timely reviewed and documented appropriately
* Ensure the employees meet the required Training norms as stipulated by appropriate authorities. Maintain the records and keep ready for audit / inspection as and when required
* Audit readiness. Work within the department and with the functions to ensure that the organization is geared up for various audits, related pre and post actions of audit. 100% success is our aim
* Ensure that the manufacturing sites has all relevant statutory certifications, licenses while working with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure to maintain the industrial harmony while working with unions and line of business. Take all actions that required to be complied with the law of the land
* Ensure our organization complies with all statutory requirements on all labor related matters and adhere to the requirements
* Ensure good employee relations & foster bonding among the employees
* Be aware of the latest developments, judgments in all matters concerned to our operations and implement the changes / amendments
* Disciplinary matters: Ensure that discipline is maintained at all levels across sites
* Quality & Environment Management Systems implementation related to HR to be ensured

title: Operations Manger - Retail
description:

**internal management of the organization**

**hiring, onboarding, and training employees**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITY**

title: Management Trainee
description:
Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job
  
  
Interpret, analyze, read, and make recommendations that improve a workforce with an eye on reducing overhead and increasing productivity and reducing employee costs. Serve as a primary point of contact for workforce management policies and are subject matter experts on workforce optimization steps. They ensure service-level targets are being met and maintain the proper headcount while calculating call capacity. Role is responsible for compiling, structuring, and analyzing human resources data to make conclusions that help streamline all processes. Key competencies include data analysis, business acumen, relationship management, HR expertise, communication, HR systems, and cultural awareness. Hands-on knowledge of SAP Success Factors would be required.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  

* Implementation of all modules of SAP Success Factors.
* Gather benchmark data about jobs, compensation and benefits
* Map out salary ranges for our open positions
* Calculate retention, turnover and internal mobility rates
* Report on key recruiting metrics like time to fill and hiring costs
* Assist hiring managers in designing hiring and training plans
* Forecast costs by department and help create budgets
* Analyze employees’ answers to internal surveys (like job satisfaction surveys)
* Assess results from our employee performance reviews
* Identify top reasons why candidates and employees choose to work with our company and

recommend areas of improvement for our HR procedures
  
  

* Collect, clean, and analyze HR data from various sources, including HRIS (Human

Resources Information System), performance management systems, employee surveys,
  
  
and other relevant platforms.
  
  

* Utilize statistical and analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, and correlations in HR data.
* Conduct predictive and prescriptive analytics to anticipate future HR needs and provide

strategic recommendations.
  
  

* Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to visualize key metrics and

performance indicators.
  
  

* Regularly provide HR leaders and stakeholders with actionable insights based on data

analysis.
  
  

* Collaborate with HR and business leaders to understand workforce dynamics and

contribute to workforce planning initiatives.
  
  

* Analyse workforce trends, including turnover, retention, and succession planning, to

support strategic talent management decisions.
  
  

* Stay updated on HR analytics trends, tools, and best practices to enhance the analytical

capabilities within the HR function.
  
  

* Propose and implement process improvements to streamline data collection and analysis.
* Manage the development of real time automated HR dashboards like Hiring, Attrition,

Diversity, Performance, Talent Management dashboards to analyse organizational trends
  
  
of employees from Hire to Retire.
  
  

* Perform workforce Analytics to understand the effect of Employee Engagement in

enhancing the productivity of the store & front-line employees
  
  

* Developed a real -time one stop shop dashboard for workforce catering to the Business

need
  
  

* Lead all the data & streamline them.

SAP SuccessFactors
  
  
HR Analytics
  
  
HRIS Management
  
  
Compensation Benchmarking
  
  
Workforce Planning
  
  
Dashboard Reporting
  
  
Excel, SQL & Power BI
  
  
**Behavioural**
Analytical Thinking
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Strategic Planning
  
  
Decision Making
  
  
Communication

title: Executive
description:
Principal Tasks &Responsibilities
  
  

* Employee Lifecycle Transactions

After receiving EC trigger intimation from the TA team, ensure thorough one-to-one verification of all uploaded documents in Digicad. Obtain IFSC approval for new bank details to generate the employee code and coordinate closely with SFE (SPOC) for creation of Phyzii login within the defined TAT of 24 hours. Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters to all new joiners and maintain proper documentation throughout the onboarding process.
  
  

* Induction Program

Plan and conduct induction training sessions for all new joiners under the FLP program, ensuring they are well briefed about organizational policies, processes, and role expectations to enable smooth integration into the organization.
  
  

* Bags, visiting cards

Ensure all FLP participants receive their official bags and visiting cards prior to leaving the Bhat office campus, coordinating with relevant teams to avoid delays or shortages.
  
  

* Letters & communication

Ensure timely preparation and release of all manual letters including transfer, promotion, demotion, revocation, etc., as per communication received from HRBP. Update revised CTC details in the system accurately and submit the required hard copies to Payroll. In cases of transfer or relocation, ensure all necessary clearances and approvals are obtained. Share complete and accurate data with the Phyzii team and ensure corresponding updates are consistently reflected in Digicad.
  
  

* Leave Management

Ensure timely manual updation of leaves in Phyzii for field employees as per defined eligibility. Upload region-wise annual holiday calendars in Phyzii and verify post-upload for any exceptions or exertions. Ensure data accuracy before moving changes live in the system.
  
  

* Probation extension & confirmation

Ensure all actions related to employee confirmation and probation extension are completed within timelines in both Digicad and Phyzii. Update revised leave entitlements in Phyzii wherever applicable to ensure correct leave balances.
  
  

* Field Salary

Ensure regular updation of attendance in Phyzii and actively track absenteeism cases. Follow up with employees who fail to submit reports on time and share consolidated attendance reports with Payroll prior to salary processing. Provide attendance data to Payroll for timely processing of salary advances in cases where DAR is not updated. Since Digicad and Phyzii are not integrated, manually coordinate LWP reversals in the upcoming payroll cycle (within 60 days eligibility). During salary processing, manually review cases where reporting is missing for more than 20 days and conduct one-to-one verification.
  
  

* Exit cases detachment

Ensure all resigned employee cases are detached from Phyzii after one-to-one confirmation from HRPO and verification of the employee’s last working day. In cases where reporting exists beyond the last working date, ensure reports are deleted date-wise on an individual basis.
  
  

* Full & Final Settlement

Post resignation, share clearance communication with the exiting employee and collect all required documents such as NOC, clearance approvals, tablet submission confirmation, etc. Ensure completion of long-pending Full & Final settlements (including cases pending since 2022) by coordinating closely with the Finance department for timely closure.
  
  

* Bank Account Details & Address updation

Update employee bank account details on a daily basis as and when information is shared. Ensure timely approvals in Digicad and verify updates for processing in SAP. Manually share residential address details of field force employees with the IT department, including required codes, to ensure smooth postal dispatch.
  
  

* Mediclaim & MGEBS loan

Ensure end-to-end completion of the mediclaim process, starting from sharing intimation emails to coordinating with employees and forwarding documents to the insurance team. Actively follow up on missing or incorrect documentation to avoid delays. For MGEBS loan processing, coordinate with employees to collect required supporting documents and submit them to the concerned department for further processing.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Purpose Of Role**
To administer and support HR technology platforms, ensure smooth system operations, maintain data accuracy, enable users, and improve HR processes through effective configuration, testing, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core System Administration & Configuration

uKnowva HRMS: Handle day-to-day administration, module setups (Onboarding, Attendance, Leave, Performance Management), resolve user tickets, and maintain accurate employee master data.
  
  
Phenom (Talent CRM): Manage candidate pipeline workflows, optimize career site landing pages, set up nurture email campaigns, and configure automated chatbot pathways for applicants.
  
  
Otomeyt Testing: Coordinate pre-employment assessment setups, assign technical and behavioral tests to candidates based on role requisitions, monitor test delivery, and troubleshoot technical glitches.
  
  
Qualtrics EX: Configure, test, and launch employee lifecycle surveys (Onboarding, Pulse, Annual Engagement, Exit), manage distribution lists, and format raw survey output for analysis.
  
  
Tableau Dashboards: Refresh, update, and build routine operational HR reports and basic interactive dashboards in Tableau to track metrics like time-to-hire, attrition, and survey response rates.
  
  

* Testing & Quality Assurance (QA)

Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all software updates, patches, workflow tweaks, and system integrations across uKnowva, Phenom, Otomeyt, and Qualtrics.
  
  
Test API integrations and data syncing between platforms to identify data drops, field mapping errors, or latency issues before live rollout.
  
  

* Operational Support & End-User Enablement

Act as the First Point of Contact (Tier 1 & Tier 2 support) for employees, recruiters, and managers facing access issues or platform bugs.
  
  
Create and update User Guides, SOPs, and short video walkthroughs to train new hires and HR team members on system utilization.
  
  
Manage vendor support tickets (Phenom, Otomeyt, uKnowva, Qualtrics), tracking them through resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  

* Data Governance & Reporting

Perform routine data audits across platforms to ensure data integrity, field consistency, and compliance with data privacy standards.
  
  
Extract cross-platform reports to support monthly and quarterly HR business reviews.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Functional / Technical**
HRMS Platform Administration (uKnowva, Phenom, Otomeyt, Qualtrics EX)
  
  
System Configuration, Role Management & Bulk Data Uploads
  
  
Advanced Excel, Basic SQL & Data Validation
  
  
UAT Testing, Bug Tracking & Resolution
  
  
Basic Understanding of APIs, Webhooks & SSO
  
  
Tableau Reporting & Dashboard Creation
  
  
**Behavioural**
Strong attention to detail
  
  
Problem-solving & root cause analysis
  
  
Customer service orientation
  
  
Adaptability & quick learning ability
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Staff Global Business Partner
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Staff Global Business Partner (GBP)**
to partner with site leadership.
  
  
This is a senior HR business partnering role for an individual who can operate at both strategic and operational depth, translating business priorities into organization, workforce and talent strategies while staying closely connected to leaders and teams at the point of operations.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing strong business acumen, independent judgment and people expertise to complex organizational decisions. The role requires someone who can see around corners, connect signals across the organization and external environment, challenge constructively, and translate insights into practical actions that improve organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent readiness and employee experience.
  
  
The GBP will work closely with the Global Executive Business Partner (GEBP), Country People Leaders (CPLs), site and functional leadership, HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations and People Services to ensure global People strategies translate effectively into the local operating environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic People & Organization Leadership**

* Translate business strategy, operating priorities and future capability requirements into a clear, forward-looking people agenda.
* Advise leaders on organization design, workforce strategy, capability building, leadership effectiveness and talent priorities, connecting near-term business requirements with longer-term organizational health.
* Understand the business beyond the People agenda, including operating priorities, organizational dependencies, workforce dynamics and external market factors that may affect talent or execution.
* Anticipate emerging organizational and workforce risks and opportunities, bringing forward recommendations before issues become critical.
* Balance global consistency with local effectiveness, adapting implementation approaches while preserving the intent of enterprise frameworks.

**Senior Leader Partnership & Coaching**

* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leaders, bringing an independent point of view grounded in business context, data and organizational insight.
* Coach leaders through complex organization, talent, leadership and workforce decisions.
* Constructively challenge assumptions and help leaders understand the people and organizational implications of business decisions.
* Strengthen leadership effectiveness and accountability, particularly during periods of rapid growth, transformation or uncertainty.
* Build strong relationships deeper into the organization to maintain a direct understanding of business realities and emerging people issues.

**Organization & Talent**

* Shape organization and workforce plans that build the capabilities required for future business needs.
* Lead succession planning, talent reviews, leadership pipeline development and critical talent interventions.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and mobilize the appropriate development, hiring, movement or succession strategies.
* Enable talent movement and development across organizations, sites and geographies rather than solving talent needs within organizational boundaries alone.
* Partner with leaders to strengthen team effectiveness, leadership capability and organizational health.

**Team Member Insights, Culture & Change**

* Maintain a strong pulse on the organization through employee listening, leader engagement, workforce data and close connection to operations.
* Connect seemingly separate employee, talent, organizational and business signals to identify underlying themes and emerging risks.
* Help leaders navigate complex change with clarity, empathy and execution discipline, ensuring that decisions are understood and translated effectively through the organization.
* Strengthen leadership capability to communicate context, listen effectively and close the loop on employee feedback.
* Partner with leaders to anticipate how AI will reshape work, roles, skills and workforce needs, translating implications into talent and organization strategies.
* Champion Micron values and foster an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture.

**Data, Insights & Decision Quality**

* Using AI to enhance workforce analytics and organizational insights to move leaders from data to diagnosis to action, rather than simply reporting metrics.
* Integrate quantitative data with qualitative signals from leaders, team members and the external environment to develop a holistic view of organizational health.
* Identify trends, challenge assumptions and develop executive-ready insights that support timely leadership decisions.
* Define measurable outcomes for key people priorities and maintain accountability for impact and follow-through.
* Partner across People teams to improve data quality and decision effectiveness where gaps exist.

**Enterprise Partnership & Execution**

* Connect effectively across GEBP, CPL, site leadership, COEs, Employee Relations, People Services and other partners to deliver integrated solutions.
* Bring the right expertise together around business problems rather than acting as the sole owner of every HR activity.
* Influence global and regional People solutions by bringing forward local business insights and implementation learnings.
* Lead critical People initiatives from diagnosis through execution, ensuring clear ownership, disciplined follow-through and measurable outcomes.
* Simplify and prioritize work to focus HRBP capacity on activities that create the greatest business and organizational value.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's/Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 to 10 years HR Business Partner experience supporting complex, matrixed and operationally intensive organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organization, workforce, talent and leadership matters.
* Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to understand operating priorities and translate them into people and organization implications.
* Strong AI fluency, with demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve work, generate insights and support business and people decisions.
* Demonstrated capability in several of the following areas:

+ organization design and effectiveness
+ strategic workforce planning
+ talent and succession management
+ leadership coaching
+ organizational change
+ employee engagement and organizational health
+ people analytics and insight generation

* Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively without relying on positional authority.
* Strong judgment and comfort operating independently in complex or ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex issues into concise recommendations and executive-level narratives.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting semiconductor, manufacturing, engineering or other complex technology/operations environments.
* Experience working within a multinational, matrixed organization across multiple countries or sites.
* Experience partnering across global and local HR teams and translating enterprise programs into locally effective solutions.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**
We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life
*for all*
. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
  
  
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

description:

description:

Job Title: Labour Welfare Officer
  
  
Sanand (BOL), 382110
  
  
India
  
  
Required Travel: 0 - 10%
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities of a Labour Welfare Officer**

* Provide Labour Compliance Governance & Statutory Coverage by serving as the designated Labour Welfare Officer (a mandatory statutory requirement under applicable labour laws) and ensuring compliance with labour regulations, government inspections, audits, contract labour governance, and related regulatory obligations.
* Lead Government, Union & External Stakeholder Engagement to support regulatory compliance, constructive labour relations, collective bargaining processes, and proactive IR risk mitigation.
* Protect Workforce Stability & Business Continuity through proactive management of industrial relations risks, employee relations matters, conflict resolution, and sustained shopfloor engagement.
* Serve as the designated Labour Welfare Officer in accordance with applicable provisions of the Factories Act and relevant labour legislation.
* Ensure full compliance with labour laws, factory regulations, welfare provisions, social security requirements, and employment legislation.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, licenses, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, and interactions with Factory Inspectorate, Labour Department, ESIC, EPFO, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory returns, reports, and government filings.

**Industrial Relations & Employee Engagement**

* Foster positive industrial relations and maintain a harmonious work environment across the plant.
* Act as a trusted resource for employee concerns, grievances, and workplace issues.
* Support grievance handling, dispute resolution, and employee counseling activities.
* Facilitate communication between management and shop-floor employees to improve engagement and mutual trust.
* Participate in employee meetings, engagement forums, and welfare committees.

**Contract Labour Compliance**

* Monitor compliance of contractor workforce deployed within the plant.
* Coordinate with contractor representatives to ensure adherence to labour laws, wage payments, welfare provisions, statutory benefits, and licensing requirements.
* Conduct periodic audits and reviews of contractor compliance documentation.
* Support implementation of company standards for contract workforce welfare and working conditions.

**Government & External Stakeholder Liaison**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with labour authorities, local administration, community bodies, and external welfare organizations.
* Represent the organization during labour inspections, welfare reviews, and statutory interactions.
* Support management on labour-related matters, investigations, and government correspondence.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Track welfare, industrial relations, and compliance metrics and prepare periodic reports for management review.
* Analyze workforce trends and recommend initiatives to improve employee satisfaction and workplace effectiveness.
* Drive continuous improvement in welfare programs and employee engagement practices.

**Key Performance Measures**
**Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain 100% compliance with applicable labour laws, welfare provisions, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Successful completion of labour inspections and regulatory audits without significant non-conformities.

**Contract Labour Governance**

* High levels of contractor compliance with statutory and company requirements.
* Effective monitoring of contract workforce welfare and legal compliance.

**Employee Engagement**

* Increased participation in employee welfare, communication, and engagement programs.

**Functional Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian Labour Laws, Industrial Relations and Factory Compliance.
* Thorough understanding of the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code and other applicable labour regulations.
* Employee counseling and grievance-handling capabilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Conflict resolution and negotiation abilities.
* Ability to influence and build credibility across all organizational levels.
* Strong analytical and compliance-focused mindset.
* Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.

**Experience-**

* 5-7 years of experience in Labour Welfare, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations or Plant Human Resources within a manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Knowledge of HRMS and statutory compliance systems.

**Travel or Physical Demands**

* Regular presence on the shop floor and engagement with production employees, supervisors, and contractors.
* Ability to move within manufacturing and warehouse areas while complying with all safety protocols.
* Periodic travel to government offices, labour authorities, training programs, and local community events.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across all levels, from shop-floor associates to plant leadership.

**Location**
– Allison Off Highway, Sanand, Gujarat , India
  
  
**Educational Background**

* Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW) or Master's Degree in Labour Welfare (MLW) from a recognized university. (Mandatory)
* Additional qualification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, or Human Resources will be advantageous.

**Reporting To -**
Plant HR Manager

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Company Description**
Aquascape Engineers Pvt Ltd is an engineering organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality solutions to clients in its sector. The company values operational excellence, strong project management, and collaborative teamwork to meet customer expectations. Aquascape Engineers Pvt Ltd promotes a professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow, take ownership of their responsibilities, and contribute to continuous improvement. The organization emphasizes integrity, safety, and compliance with applicable standards in all its operations. It aims to build long-term partnerships by providing consistent service and support.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Human Resources Generalist role based in Daskroi. The Human Resources Generalist will manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee onboarding and offboarding, maintaining employee records, and assisting with payroll and benefits administration in coordination with relevant teams. The role involves supporting recruitment activities, scheduling interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience. The HR Generalist will handle routine employee queries, support performance management processes, assist with training and development initiatives, and help implement HR policies and procedures. The role also includes supporting compliance with labor laws and company policies, preparing HR reports, and contributing to a positive, inclusive workplace culture.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and HR compliance.
* Ability to maintain accurate HR documentation and employee records, with attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with employees and managers at all levels.
* Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with HR software, spreadsheets, and standard office applications; comfort working with data and basic reporting.
* Knowledge of relevant labor laws and HR best practices; willingness to stay updated on regulatory changes.
* Problem-solving mindset, with the ability to address employee concerns professionally and support conflict resolution.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; relevant HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in an HR Generalist or similar HR role, ideally within an engineering, industrial, or corporate environment.

title: Lead Trainer - L&D
description:
**Job Title: Lead Trainer \- L\&D** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




**Shift: 02:00 PM to 11:30 PM** 




  





 Experience: 3 \+ Yrs as a Behavioral/Soft Skills Trainer.
 



 Voice \& Accent Training/Language Training
 



  





 Certification(s): Train The Trainer Certification, or Relevant PG program in Training
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The role primarily of the Lead Trainer is to take up training delivery and content development related activities. The role also entails tasks related to learning management system administration and coordination.
 



  





**What you'll be responsible for:** 




**Training Delivery**




 Manage the learning environment and prepare for training delivery.
 



 Convey objectives and align learning solutions with course objectives and learner needs.
 



 Create a positive learning climate and establish credibility as an Instructor.
 



 Use various learning methodologies to facilitate learning.
 



 Encourage participation and build learner motivation.
 



 Deliver constructive feedback to ensure learning outcomes.
 



  





**Content Development**




 Use instructional design theories and models to design, develop, and/or revamp behavioral and soft skills traning content for virtual and classroom training interventions.
 



 Conduct performance analysis to identify goals, gaps, or opportunities.
 



 Design and implement performance support systems and tools, for example instructional resources, data, process models, job aids, and expert advice.
 



 Design and develop learning assets, for example role plays, self\-assessments, training manuals, job aids, and visual aids that align to a desired learning or behavioral outcome.
 



  





**L\&D Coordination**




 Manage the L\&D functional mailbox while addressing, resolving, and/or escalating all queries and requests in a timely manner.
 



 Release the L\&D training calendar in a timely manner.
 



 Develop, administer, and debrief results of assessments of intelligence, aptitude, potential, skill, ability, and/or interests.
 



 Facilitate career development planning process by coordinating with supervisors/managers for helping employees identify needs and career goals, and prepare and execute individual development plans.
 



 Use data collection tools, for example questionnaires, surveys, and structured interviews to gather real time training needs.
 



 Use qualitative and quantitative data through observations, interviews, focus groups, surveys, and/or assessments to to analyze and showcase training impact.
 



 Help individuals or teams identify goals, develop realistic action plans, seek development opportunities, and monitor progress and accountability.
 



 Coordinate, administer and track the learning interventions as directed by the Learning and Development Manager.
 



 Maintain repository of approved training content.
 



  





**LMS Administration**




 Manage the Learning module of SAP Success Factors.
 



 Maximize the utilization of all the LMS features.
 



 Maintain and develop processes, projects, and tasks related to tracking and publishing management information and training data of all the learning interventions hosted on Success Factors LMS.
 



 Use learning management system and tools to generate learning reports and publish them to the stakeholders in a timely manner.
 



 Work with the other trainer(s) and SLHs to ensure that the requisite training related data is uploaded and accessible on LMS on a real time basis.
 



 Work with the lms consultants to resolve technical glitches and suggest ways to achieve desired outcomes
 



  





 What you'll need
 



 Planning and Organizing
 



 Process Orientation
 



 Communication Skills
 



 Creativity and Innovation
 



 Achievement Orientation
 



 Collaboration
 



 Interpersonal Effectiveness
 



  





 Visit www.advantmed.com to learn more about our organization
